title: Dark rock's rubble lands off-centre
description: The player breaks a brick with a mattock, and its rubble falls where the brick stood. He jumps a pit and breaks a block of the Ice Caves' dark rock: its rubble comes out to the right of the block and below it, and falls past the block's edge.
